title: The Case for ‘Thick Evaluations’ of Cultural Representation in AI

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative, community-centered 'thick evaluations' involving pre-workshop surveys to generate culturally relevant prompts, individual evaluation tasks of AI-generated images, and discursive workshops with participants from Sri Lanka, Pakistan, and India to analyze generated images across dimensions such as incorrectness, missingness, specificity, coherence, and connotations.
